description: This file implements the 'Component' class and related classes for Android's Codec2 media framework, including listener wrappers, input sink management, component lifecycle methods, and interaction with buffer pools and surfaces.

classes.name: Component::Listener
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing C2Component::Listener to handle callbacks such as errors, tripped states, and work completion.

classes.name: Component::Sink
classes.description: Input sink implementation for the Component, managing registration and lookup of local C2Component instances.

classes.name: BlockPoolIntf
classes.description: Internal class implementing configurable interface for C2BlockPool.

methods.name: Component::queue
methods.description: Queues work items to the component after registering input buffers.

methods.name: Component::flush
methods.description: Flushes the component and unregisters input buffers.

methods.name: Component::drain
methods.description: Drains the component, optionally with EOS.

methods.name: Component::setOutputSurface
methods.description: Sets the output surface for the component.

methods.name: Component::connectToOmxInputSurface
methods.description: Connects to an OMX input surface.

methods.name: Component::asInputSink
methods.description: Returns the component as an input sink.

methods.name: Component::setOutputSurfaceWithSyncObj
methods.description: Sets output surface with synchronization object.

methods.name: Component::findLocalComponent
methods.description: Finds local C2Component from an input sink.

methods.name: Component::initListener
methods.description: Initializes the component listener and death recipient.
